mapper.select: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, secn.N_Scope as nScope, secn.N_Bidding_Type as nBiddingType, c1.C_Name as tendereeName, c2.C_Name as nBiddingAgencyName, c2.C_Abbreviation as nBidAgeAbbName, sqg.* from Sec_QE_Group sqg left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=sqg.Sec_Id left join Sec_Notice secn on sec.Sec_Id=secn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on secn.N_Bidding_Agency=c2.C_Id where sqg.Qeg_Id=#{qegId}
